secrets.name: PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (e.g. https://xxxxx.supabase.co) from Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project URL.

secrets.name: PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/public API key from Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project API keys (anon public).

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service_role secret key for server-side admin ops (image upload, store claim preview). From Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API → Project API keys (service_role).
